name: Yonex Astrox 70 badminton racket ( Master Copy )
description:
Yonex Astrox 70 Badminton Racket

Brand: Yonex
Model: Astrox 70
Type: Badminton Racket Bat
Flex: Stiff
Shaft: H.M. Graphite with NANOMETRIC technology
Frame: H.M. Graphite, Tungsten-infused
Weight / Grip Size:

3U: Avg. 88g (G4, G5)

4U: Avg. 83g (G4, G5)
Stringing Advice:

3U: 20–28 lbs

4U: 18–26 lbs
Balance: Head-Heavy / Medial (for attacking play)
Features:

Rotational Generator System for better control and balance

High-modulus graphite shaft for powerful smashes

Lightweight design for fast swings and agility

Ideal for advanced and professional players

Highlights:

Perfect for aggressive attacking style

Combines power, speed, and precision

Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip
